messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@retailco.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap and packaging question

Hi Naomi,

Hope you're well. Our team is two weeks into the pilot and we like the latency profile, but we need to run another 4-week window for a broader product slice. The current pilot ends 2026-07-26 — is there a way to (a) extend by 4 weeks and (b) switch to a tiered "seat" bundle where we pay for a base of 2 seats and add ephemeral seats at a discounted rate?

Also: a blocker for Procurement is the lack of an explicit 24/7 engineering support option during this expanded runway — they want an SLA we can purchase for the pilot period. Can you send pricing and a PO template we can use?

Thanks,
Samir

Hi Samir — great to hear the team is seeing promising results.

We can absolutely set up a 4-week extension with a tiered seat bundle and a separately priced engineering support SKU. I attached a draft pricing sheet (staggered_seat_pricing_v2.pdf) and a one-page support SLA (redwood_support-sla.pdf) for your review. High level: 

- Pilot window: +28 days from 2026-07-27 to 2026-08-23
- Bundle idea: base 2 seats included; additional seats billed per-seat, discounted at 40% for the pilot period
- Engineering support: 24/7 on-call for critical incidents, priced as a weekly block (see SLA doc)

If Procurement is OK with the structure, send the PO template and I'll route a short amendment/PO work order for signatures. I can also set a 30-minute call this afternoon to walk through numbers.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot wrap and packaging question — quick pricing ask

Ben/Marissa — looping you in. RetailCo wants a 4-week extension with a tiered seat bundle + 24/7 eng support as a purchasable add-on. They explicitly said Procurement needs an SLA and a PO template.

My proposed commercial posture for negotiation (open to pushback):
- Core: 2-seat base for pilot duration; additional seats billed at $1,200/seat/week list price, offer 40% pilot discount => $720/seat/week.
- For a 4-week extension with an estimated 5 seats average (2 base + 3 extra), list math: ((2*0) + (3 * $720)) * 4 = $8,640 pilot add-on.
- Engineering support: offer a compact 24/7 package at $6,000/week (covers on-call rotation + 2 dedicated escalation hours/day + twice-weekly sync).
- Time-limited incentive: if they sign PO by 2026-07-20, give an extra 1-week free on the extension (effectively 5 weeks billed as 4).

Questions: 1) Do we have flexibility on the eng-support list price? 2) Any objections to the 40% seat discount for pilot conversion economics? I'm mindful of keeping runway cost low for them while preserving conversion levers.

— Naomi

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot wrap and packaging question — quick pricing ask

Thanks Naomi — I like the approach but recommend tightening the numbers to reduce friction with Procurement. Suggested adjustments: 

- Seat pricing: make the per-seat/week pilot price $600 (we can show list at $1,200 with a pilot 50% discount) — simpler math and looks like a stronger concession. For 3 extra seats x 4 weeks => $7,200.
- Engineering support: bump to $12,000 flat for the 4-week block (vs $6k/week) — Packaging as a single line item makes the PO cleaner. We can justify as "pilot-grade 24/7 coverage + weekly runbook deliverables."
- Incentive: keep the "sign by 7/20 for +1 week free" but require a PO AND a short statement of use to qualify.

If we present it as a tidy line-item commercial (Bundle: $7,200; 24/7 support: $12,000; Total = $19,200) it will be easier for Procurement to slot into their Purchase Order. Legal should do a quick read on the SLA doc but I don't expect issues.

I'll stand behind these numbers. Happy to hop on a call with Samir and Naomi at 3pm PT.

— Ben

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@retailco.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 16:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap and packaging question

Naomi — thanks for the fast turnaround. We reviewed your recommended package with Procurement and they prefer tidy line items (helps customs/approval). The math below looks acceptable:

- Tiered seat bundle (estimated avg 5 seats): $7,200
- 24/7 pilot engineering support (4-week block): $12,000
- Total: $19,200

Procurement has two small asks: include a 1-week grace extension clause in the amendment (we may need to shift dates by a week) and provide your PO-ready pricing page (we attached a simple PO template; please return a populated version). Once we have the populated PO and the DocuSign link for the amendment, Procurement will route internally (I copied them on this thread).

If you can get the populated PO and DocuSign by EOD Monday (2026-07-20), we should be able to sign and take the +1 week incentive.

Appreciate the flexibility — Samir
